about: The material lab's second woods (tools/textures/grain_woods.py; Sean's reference pack of 2026-10-14, docs/concept/material_pack/: grounded 3D, controlled stylization, the approved saloon exterior docs/concept/approved-saloon-exterior.png the target). Colours are the woods' own (sRGB, dark to light), set from the approved exterior with its golden light taken off, never the light baked in. Every wood: `texels_per_metre` (128: a texel 8 mm, mipmapped, so far off it averages instead of shimmering), `rows` texels across a board (its strip repeats every rows/texels_per_metre m across the member), `count` boards, `seed`. A board: `base` [mean, spread] its place on `ramp` (one coherent colour a piece), `patch` [amount, length m, width m] the large soft areas of tone along it, `levels` how many flat tones the patches are stepped into (the stylization: painted patches, not noise), `grain` [amount, spacing m, wander m] the fine lines along the length, `knot` [chance, size m], `checks` [count range, length m] dark splits along the grain, `saw` [amount, spacing m] faint marks across it, `edge` lightening of the worn long edges. Painted woods: `paint` (true), `wear` [amount, near edges, near nails], `under` the bare wood's ramp, `nails` places along the 2 m (m). `end`: the end-grain face's colours (darker, it soaks up weather), `rings` [spacing m, amount] (broad stylized bands, at least 2-3 texels: real rings of 2-6 mm alias at 8 mm texels), `pith` the growth centre's distance below the face (m, a flat-sawn board's arcs), `end_checks` chance.

timber.what: weathered structural timber: posts, beams, braces (the approved exterior's grey-tan posts)

floor.what: exterior boardwalk and porch planks, rough-sawn, foot-worn and weathered

saloon_red.what: red painted lap siding, faded: the paint one coherent colour, worn to bare wood at the lap edges and nails (muted brick: the approved exterior's sunlit red is L* ~18-25, chroma ~30; the first ramp went vivid under the low sun)

store_boards.what: pale cream-grey painted store boards, aged and dirty

weathered_pine.what: bare weathered pine boards: side walls, the walk's fascia, porch roof boards (greyer than the posts: thinner boards, more sun)

framing.what: rough-sawn framing lumber: studs, sleepers, joists, plain posts (fresher, warmer, saw-marked)

dark_trim.what: dark brown painted or oiled trim: door and window frames, sills, rails (smoother, defined edges)
